classification.difficultyReason: Part (a) is a scaffolded reverse-percentage step: 30% of the boys is 12, so find 1% and then 100%. Part (b) uses that result as the 4 parts of the 4:5 ratio to find the girls. The two-stage chain across percentage and ratio is more demanding than a one-stage ratio share. There is no further percentage-of-women step, so it is easier than p42-q12 and below p42-q11, which needs an unscaffolded fraction-to-ratio reframing.
